pages.text: The headless ratman familiar steals the heads of mobs killed nearby and remembers that type of mob.$(br)$(bold)Upgrade Behaviour$()$(br)Upgraded by a blacksmith familiar, it applies weakness to nearby mobs matching the stolen head type.$(br)If it drops $(bold)$()
below 50% health$() it dies, but its master can rebuild it with $(item)wheat$(), $(item)stick$(), $(item)hay block$() and a $(item)pumpkin$().
